description: Update an existing contact's details. If notes are provided, they are appended as a new structured note entry without overwriting existing notes.

doNotAutoRespond.description: Set true so the bot never auto-responds to this contact, false to allow (manual/API and human sends are unaffected either way)

doNotBroadcast.description: Set true to exclude this contact from all broadcasts, false to allow

email.description: Updated email address for the contact

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the contact to update

name.description: Updated full name for the contact

notes.description: New note to append to the contact's existing notes

phone.description: Updated phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +2348012345678)

tags.description: Updated tags for the contact (replaces existing tags)

name: neuron_update_contact
title: Update Contact
